scientific_limitations: A stationary Cox-reset Brownian model with independently Poisson-refreshed environment only; complete positional resets do not refresh the rate.
The scaling limits are pointwise in fixed scaled time or logarithmic lag and concern the slow-refresh parameter tending to zero.
The stationary spatial characteristic transform is established prior work; the contribution is the temporal covariance, critical indices, and full scaling profiles.
A broader stochastic-process theorem may subsume some or all consequences; independent publication-priority and mathematical audits are not performed.
title: Critical temporal-memory regimes for Brownian diffusion with a slowly refreshed stochastic reset rate
